title: Rounded, no rod
blurb: The drapes form a soft app-icon square on their own; the rod is gone and the hem corners are rounded.

title: Tied back
blurb: Each drape is pinched at the waist the way a theatre curtain is tied, opening a tall pink window.

title: Pleats
blurb: Each drape is three rounded pleats narrowing toward the middle, with a pink pleat of light in the centre.

title: Rod and hem
blurb: The original, softened: a rounded rod, rounded outer corners, and a gently waved hem.

title: Arch of light
blurb: A solid rounded square with the parting cut out as a pointed arch, so the drapes are implied by what is left.

title: Line drapes
blurb: Two thick curved strokes under a rod, like brackets pulling apart, with the light filling the space between.

title: Finials and rings
blurb: Ball finials on the rod, rings holding the drapes, two fold grooves per drape and a scalloped hem.

title: Valance
blurb: A scalloped pelmet across the top instead of a bare rod, with folded drapes hanging from it.

title: Tiebacks
blurb: The drapes are gathered at the waist with pink ties, so the opening swells in the middle.

title: Deep folds
blurb: Three fold grooves per drape, each ending in its own scallop at the hem, under a finial rod.

title: On stage
blurb: The finial version standing on a stage floor, with the pink light spilling out onto it.
